objectives: Learn a classification model from simulated data (classification) that solves: Classify samples from a synthetic 3-class problem with 20 features (8 informative).

data.title: svm on 'log' features

data.title: extra_trees on 'raw' features
data.hypothesis: Extremely randomised trees; lower variance than random forests, fast. Using 'raw' features tests whether a ensemble learner captures the target map under the tree ensembles and gradient boosting for robust nonlinear function approximation lens.

data.title: random_forest on 'raw' features

data.title: torch_mlp on 'raw' features
data.hypothesis: PyTorch MLP (LayerNorm, GELU, AdamW, cosine LR, early stopping). Uses a GPU if allocated. Using 'raw' features tests whether a neural learner captures the target map under the neural networks: architecture, regularisation and optimisation choices lens.
